evidence_items.claim: Citi is among G-SIB backers of digital derivatives reporting project
evidence_items.excerpt: Bank of America Merrill Lynch, BNP Paribas, Citi, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan are among the project's backers; Bloomberg is also participating. The project is training 25 G-SIB-supplied specialists to study the data fields required for the EMIR refit implementation.

evidence_items.claim: Citi sponsored first FINOS hackathon in India
evidence_items.excerpt: Citi is proud to launch the very first FINOS supported hackathon in India! This hybrid event is open to employees from FINOS Member Companies and students in India.

evidence_items.claim: Citi participates in FINOS AI governance framework
evidence_items.excerpt: FINOS Members including Citi, Scott Logic, Morgan Stanley, ControlPlane, Microsoft, London Stock Exchange Group, Publicis Sapient, Databricks, EPAM and Provectus collaborate to develop a governance framework for the onboarding, development and running of AI-based solutions within financial services.
